instagram.body:
Is college the only route to a high-paying IT job? 📚

Still thinking college is your only option for a six-figure IT career? Comment “LEVELUP” and I’ll show you the faster path!

#networkengineering #itcareers #highpayingcareers #itjobs #techcareer #techjobs
Stitch incoming. 

Studying Cybersecurity... 💀 Vs 
Working in Cybersecurity 🔥💼

If your FYP page is filled with videos like this, then you've probably had thoughts like, do I need to go to college to achieve a career like this? The answer is no, you don't. And our students are proof of that. You need to do this instead. Step one, pick a path. Choose AI and Big Data centers, or Cybersecurity, or Network Engineering. These are actually the top three based on the world economic high demand skills for 2030. And you need to commit to learning this craft over the next 90 days. Step two is getting certified. I would start with the Network Plus and the Security Plus from CompTIA. Set a deadline, and set aside dedicated time daily and on a weekly basis to level up. Step three is building proof. You do this by building an IT project home lab, and you build this lab every week and you build experience and you document the process. Step four, apply smartly. Apply to 10 roles a week that match your path and tailor your resume and your labs and certs and not your old job title in order to break through. Step five, train for interviews. Practice 10 to 20 commonly asked questions and rehearse them with family and friends and explain what you built, what you actually learned in terms of skills, how you fixed or troubleshoot and your results. Still thinking about college is your first option for a six-figure IT career? Comment "Levelup" and I'll show you a faster path.

Palantir Technologies is a U.S. software company that builds tools for analyzing large amounts of data. It was founded in 2003 by Peter Thiel and others, including Alex Karp. The company originally focused on helping intelligence agencies like the U.S. government connect and analyze data to detect threats and improve national security. Today, Palantir works with: * Government agencies (defense, intelligence, law enforcement) * Private companies (healthcare, finance, manufacturing) Its main products are platforms like Palantir Gotham (used by governments) and Palantir Foundry (used by businesses). These systems help organizations combine huge datasets and find patterns, risks, or insights. Palantir is often discussed because: * Supporters say it helps solve complex real-world problems * Critics raise concerns about privacy, surveillance, and government data use In simple terms: Palantir is a company that builds powerful software to turn massive amounts of data into useful decisions. #palantir #technology #data #software #ai
